//: Type checker for the client. Nothing is emitted: Vite strips the types when it bundles, and `node --test` strips them when a test imports a .ts module (Node >= 22.18), so there is no build step and nothing new ships to the browser. The client is moving from .js to .ts file by file (docs/typescript-migration.md); .js files stay unchecked (allowJs, checkJs off) until they move. Same strictness switches as server/tsconfig.json: erasableSyntaxOnly because Node cannot strip enum/namespace/parameter properties, verbatimModuleSyntax so a type-only import says `import type`.
